gtcsolo.multiblock.error.irradiation_gla: Use the same tier of Voltage Glass for every window, IV or higher.
gtcsolo.irradiation_separation_chamber.i: Irradiates the feedstock to separate the components selected by the lens. Place the lens in an Item Input Bus. Processing leaves the lens intact.
Use a single grade of Voltage Glass, IV or higher, for every window. Both the glass tier and the Energy Hatches limit the operating voltage.
When processing Enriched Naquadah Waste, the lens selects which fraction to recover first. Distill the residual liquor to recover the other fraction.
